source_refs.note: 'Validation Data Set Preparation' under topic 6.8, as printed (PDF 87, printed 83).

blocks.text: A validation dataset is separate from training and testing data that is used to check model performance. Validation data must be clean and accurate to represent real conditions. The model does not learn from validation data. Validation helps detect overfitting and improves evaluation. Balanced data gives better results. This step increases model confidence.
